"status", "dead", "status",             "death", "recur", "rel", "death"),   group = c("x", "rx", "trt", "sex", "trt", "hormon", "sex", "hormon",             "histol", "sex") ) data_of <- list(aml = survival::aml, ovarian = survival::ovarian,                 veteran = survival::veteran, lung = survival::lung,                 pbc = pbc_rand, gbsg = survival::gbsg,                 mgus2 = survival::mgus2, rotterdam = survival::rotterdam,                 nwtco = survival::nwtco, flchain = survival::flchain) sets #>         name    time  event  group #> 1        aml    time status      x mgus2  futime  death    sex #> 8  rotterdam   rtime  recur hormon #> 9      nwtco   edrel    rel histol #> 10   flchain  futime  death    sex formula_of <- function(s, cox = FALSE, strata = NULL) {   rhs <- if (cox) paste0("factor(", s$group, ")") else s$group   if (!is.null(strata)) rhs <- paste0(rhs, " + strata(", strata, ")")   as.formula(paste0("Surv(", s$time, ", ", s$event, ") ~ ", rhs)) } methods <- c("Pike", "Peto", "MH", "MH_Newton", "MH_Halley", "Pike_Halley",              "Cox_NR") tight <- coxph.control(eps = 1e-12, toler.chol = 1e-13, iter.max = 100,                        timefix = FALSE) compare <- function(i, ties = "efron", strata = NULL) {   s <- sets[i, ]   d <- data_of[[s$name]]   est <- EstHR(formula_of(s, strata = strata), data = d, method = methods,                ties = ties)   fit <- coxph(formula_of(s, cox = TRUE, strata = strata), data = d,                ties = ties, control = tight)   data.frame(dataset = s$name, n = sum(attr(est, "n")),              events = sum(attr(est, "events")), method = rownames(est),              dev = abs(est[, "coef"] - unname(coef(fit))),              se_ratio = est[, "se(coef)"] / sqrt(vcov(fit)[1, 1]),              cox_hr = unname(exp(coef(fit))), row.names = NULL) } efron <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(sets)), compare))

code: ns <- c(100, 300, 1000, 3000, 10000) reps <- 100 hr_conv <- 2 event_frac <- 0.75 conv_methods <- c("MH", "MH_Newton", "MH_Halley", "Cox_NR") conv <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(ns), function(i) {   n <- ns[i]   sim <- as.data.frame(GenSimData(nsim = reps, n_T = n / 2, n_C = n / 2,                                   hazard_C = log(2) / 18, HR = hr_conv,                                   a = 12, E = event_frac * n, seed = i))   do.call(rbind, lapply(split(sim, sim$simID), function(d) {     est <- EstHR(d$time, d$event, d$group, control = "C",                  method = conv_methods)     m <- setdiff(conv_methods, "Cox_NR")     data.frame(n = n, method = m,                dev = abs(est[m, "coef"] - est["Cox_NR", "coef"]))   })) })) med <- aggregate(dev ~ n + method, data = conv, FUN = median) slope <- function(m) {   unname(coef(lm(log10(dev) ~ log10(n), data = med[med$method == m, ]))[2]) } at_max_n <- function(m) {   x <- med[med$method == m, ]   x$dev[which.max(x$n)] } rates <- c(MH = -1 / 2, MH_Newton = -1, MH_Halley = -3 / 2) ref_lines <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(rates), function(m) {   x <- med[med$method == m, ]   x0 <- x[which.min(x$n), ]   data.frame(n = ns, method = m, dev = x0$dev * (ns / x0$n)^rates[[m]]) })) relabel <- function(x) {   x$method <- factor(x$method,                      levels = c("MH", "MH_Newton", "MH_Halley"),                      labels = c("MH", "MH-Newton", "MH-Halley"))   x } ggplot(relabel(med), aes(x = n, y = pmax(dev, 1e-16), colour = method,                          shape = method)) +   geom_line(data = relabel(ref_lines), linetype = "dashed",             show.legend = FALSE) +   geom_point(size = 2) +   geom_line() +   scale_x_log10() +   scale_y_log10() +   labs(x = "Number of subjects",        y = "Median absolute difference from Cox-NR",        colour = NULL, shape = NULL) +   theme_bw() +   theme(legend.position = "bottom")

title: Large-sample limits of the hazard ratio estimators — LimitHR
text: Let pi_T = n_T / (n_T + n_C) pi_C = 1 - pi_T, lambda_C = hazard_C, lambda_T = HR * hazard_C, lambda_D = dropout_hazard. limit, analysis takes place calendar time tau expected fraction subjects event reaches E / (n_T + n_C). Divided sample size, number risk group j time t since entry tends y_j(t) = pi_j G(t) exp(-(lambda_j + lambda_D) t), G(t) = min(1, (tau - t) / ) 0 <= t <= tau fraction subjects followed least t, sums event times EstHR() tend integrals (0, tau) respect dN(t) = (lambda_T y_T(t) + lambda_C y_C(t)) dt. example, score U(eta) divided sample size tends u(eta) = integral (lambda_T y_T q - lambda_C y_C p) dt p = y_T exp(eta) / (y_C + y_T exp(eta)) q = 1 - p, vanishes eta = log(HR). limits Mantel-Haenszel, Pike, Peto estimators obtained way, limits one-step corrections apply steps EstHR() limits score derivatives limit anchor. Cox limit root u(eta), found numerically check. integrals computed stats::integrate() relative tolerance 1e-10, split tau - tau > . Times continuous, Efron Breslow handling ties give limits, strata considered.

title: onestepcox 0.1.0
text: First version, accompanying article one-step closed-form hazard ratio estimator anchored Mantel-Haenszel estimator. EstHR() returns log hazard ratio, hazard ratio, standard error, Wald confidence interval eleven methods: proposed "MH_Halley", one-step corrections "MH_Newton", "Pike_Halley", "Pike_Newton", "MH_Chebyshev", "Pike_Chebyshev", closed-form "MH", "Pike", "Peto", Cox estimate survival::coxph() ("Cox") Newton-Raphson iteration risk-set summaries ("Cox_NR"). Tied event times handled Efron (default) Breslow method, stratification supported. EstHR() RiskTable() accept formula Surv(time, event) ~ group + strata(s) data frame, survival::coxph(), well vectors.
